correctness.rationale: An exact product factorization reduces all cases to rational inequalities; odd and five-support cases are excluded, and an extra prime divisor of psi makes six-support inequality impossible. This enforces only primes 2,3 in psi, exact support 2,3,5,7,u,v, first powers for all larger primes, and u,v with 2,3-smooth successors. The u=11 bound v<384 and u=17 bound v<576/19 are complete; a fresh executable exact certificate enumerates the corresponding 10+1 pairs and verifies every rational ratio. All converse directions follow independently.

value.rationale: The exact minimum prime-support layer of the known failure of Sándor’s conjecture is a natural structural problem. This classification identifies all eleven infinite two-exponent families at support six, including the extremely close prime-383 boundary, and globally excludes any other support/exponent structure, unlike extending a finite OEIS table.
